provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled ideal dilute sedimentation equilibrium. ln[c(r)/c(r0)]=M_b*omega^2*(r^2-r0^2)/(2*R*T), with buoyant molar mass M_b=M*(1-vbar*rho). True molar mass M and partial specific volume vbar are positive and common to all solvents; no association, nonideality or changing solvation. M is kg/mol and vbar is m^3/kg.
analysis_policy: Use all radial positions in each of the two calibration solvents to infer their buoyant masses, then separate M and vbar using the independent density change. Predict the outer-to-inner ratio in the held-out solvent at the same speed and temperature without fitting a new mass.
scope: Analytical buoyancy/mass inference from stipulated equilibrium profiles, not a centrifugation protocol or an actual molecular-weight measurement.
